text:
The readme-maps-dictate `requirements.md` is clear, so I made no rewrite. I appended a "clear" line to `flags.jsonl`.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags. The title says what it is. The owner's three asks are listed as `- [ ]` items, and the next steps are in a numbered deliverables list. It is a brief for agents, so the short-paragraph limit doesn't apply to it.
